name: ST Elementor Addons
author: Kristyna Bennett

sections.description:
ST Elementor Addons supercharges the Elementor page builder with conversion-focused widgets, WooCommerce blocks, and workflow boosters that stay lean and lightning fast. Build high-impact landing pages, shoppable product grids, interactive sliders, branded navigation, popups, and automated chat funnels in minutes—no custom code or heavyweight theme required.

Whether you are launching a store, crafting a portfolio, or scaling agency projects, ST Elementor Addons gives you pro-level design controls that remain easy to learn, accessible to clients, and optimized for Core Web Vitals.

Explore Free Themes: Free Elementor WordPress Themes
Explore the Collection of Premium Theme (Starting from $39) – Elementor WordPress Themes
Get All Themes in one WordPress Theme Bundle at just $79 – WordPress Theme Bundle

Included Widgets & Extensions

  • ST Button – Craft primary, secondary, and outline CTAs with shape, gradient, icon, and hover state controls.
  • ST Elementor Popup Builder – Design targeted popups with overlay, close-button styling, triggers, and template syncing.
  • ST Flexbox Carousel – Drop any Elementor container or widget into an autoplay slider with per-breakpoint layout controls.
  • ST Marquee – Loop announcements, offers, and icon ticks with speed, direction, and responsive spacing tweaks.
  • ST Nav Menu – Design sticky headers, mega menus, and one-page navigation that stays synced with Elementor Theme Builder.
  • ST Post Grid – Showcase blog posts or custom post types with query builder, pagination, badges, and meta toggles.
  • ST Testimonial Carousel – Highlight social proof with avatar, rating, and multi-column layouts.
  • ST Before & After Slider – Compare images with draggable handles and responsive overlay styles.
  • ST Theme Builder Integration – Replace headers, footers, product templates, and post archives with pixel-perfect Elementor layouts.

WooCommerce Widgets
– ST Product Grid – Merchandise collections with sale badges, quick view, ratings, and custom query filters.
– ST Product Select Filter – Add dropdown filters for categories, tags, attributes, or custom taxonomies.
– ST Product Checkbox Filter – Offer multi-select filtering with live product counts and AJAX-ready markup.
– ST Product Tab Filter – Organize featured, popular, or on-sale products into responsive tabs.
– ST Product Add to Cart – Place buy buttons anywhere with quantity, alignment, and variation support.
– ST Product Price – Style price, sale badge, and currency formatting independently.
– ST Product Data Tabs – Re-skin WooCommerce description, additional info, and reviews panels.
– ST Product Rating – Display average ratings with custom icons, alignment, and typography.
– ST Woo Breadcrumbs – Improve UX and schema with breadcrumb styling built for Elementor containers.
– ST Cart Page – Build custom cart experiences with order summaries, coupons, and CTA styling.
– ST Checkout Page – Redesign checkout fields, step indicators, and call-to-action layouts.

Productivity Boosters
– ST Floating Effect – Animate hero sections, icons, and CTA cards with floating, bob, or drift effects.
– ST Custom CSS – Inject widget-level CSS without editing theme files.
– ST Dynamic Tags – Bind widgets to post meta, author data, WooCommerce values, ACF fields, and the new Popup Trigger tag.
– ST Social Chat Buttons – Add WhatsApp, Messenger, Telegram, or custom chat launchers with one-click theming.

Features

  • Lightweight and optimized for fast performance.
  • Built with Elementor’s latest container system.
  • Drag-and-drop ready — no coding required.
  • Fully translation ready (.pot files included).
  • Follows WordPress development and coding standards.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/st-elementor-addons directory or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Elementor editor and search for widgets like “ST Button”, “ST Marquee”, or “ST Flexbox Carousel”.
  4. Drag and drop the widgets onto your page and customize them as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin works as an addon for Elementor and requires Elementor to be installed and activated.

Can I use this plugin with any theme?

Yes, as long as the theme supports Elementor, this plugin will work seamlessly.

Is this plugin translation ready?

Yes, the plugin is fully translation ready. You can translate it into your language using .pot files.

How do I use Dynamic Tags in this plugin?

Dynamic Tags can be used within the plugin’s widgets by selecting the “Dynamic Tags” option from the widget settings. This allows you to pull dynamic content such as post titles, author names, custom fields, and more directly into your widgets.

What is the Flexbox Carousel?

The Flexbox Carousel is a powerful Elementor container-based carousel. You can easily add any Elementor widget inside the carousel, and it will automatically display as a draggable, scrollable slider. It’s flexible, responsive, and fully customizable.
